content.text: The electric fan rattled softly as it pushed warm air around the room.
Lance sat at his desk staring at lines of code that had looked promising three hours ago and confusing for the last thirty minutes.
His apartment wasn't large. A bed occupied one corner. A cluttered workbench filled another. Loose wires, sensors, tools, and unfinished electronics projects covered nearly every available surface.
A cold cup of coffee sat beside his keyboard. Outside, motorcycles passed occasionally while someone's karaoke machine fought a losing battle against the morning heat.
A notification appeared on his monitor.

content.title: BREAKING NEWS
content.text: Violent Incident in Manila Leaves Several Injured

messages.text: Bro, somebody sent me a weird video.

content.text: Lance smirked. Another day online. Another conspiracy theory.
His stomach growled. Breakfast sounded more productive than arguing with strangers on the internet.

choices.text: Check the strange video from the group chat.
Ignore the distractions and continue working.
Take a break and make breakfast.
